# Tagesspiegel

> > Tagesspiegel is a leading Berlin-based German newspaper offering classified ads, auctions, and local news services for the Berlin and Potsdam regions.

Tagesspiegel serves the Berlin metropolitan area with comprehensive news coverage through its main publication and sister publication PNN (Potsdam). The platform includes extensive classified advertising services for real estate, jobs, and local auctions, connecting the community with commercial and cultural opportunities.
